message.content: {"summary":"A brand partnership agreement between Northwick Wellness Co. and a content creator for four sponsored posts, paid a single fee after the brand accepts the work.","flags":[{"clauseType":"ip-assignment-or-licence-scope","severity":"critical","sourceSentence":"Creator hereby assigns to Brand all right, title and interest in and to the Content, and grants Brand a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use Creator’s name, likeness, voice and biography in connection with the Content in any media now known or later developed.","whatItMeans":"The brand owns everything you make for this campaign, including drafts and unused footage, and can use your name, face and voice in any media, anywhere, forever.","whyDangerous":"You can't take this back once you sign. You lose the right to reuse your own work, and the brand can keep putting your face in ads long after the campaign and the fee are over.","counterOffer":"Creator grants Brand a non-exclusive licence to use the published Deliverables on Brand's own social media accounts for twelve (12) months from first publication. Paid media use, or use after that period, requires a separate written agreement and fee. Creator keeps ownership of all Content.","matchedRedLineId":"seed-1"},{"clauseType":"payment-terms","severity":"high","sourceSentence":"Brand will pay the Fee within ninety (90) days after Brand's written acceptance of all Deliverables, and Brand may withhold acceptance in its sole discretion.","whatItMeans":"You get paid three months after the brand says it accepts the work, and the brand can decide never to accept it.","whyDangerous":"Nothing sets a date when you must be paid, and nothing happens to the brand if it doesn't pay. You could finish every Deliverable and still have no right to the money.","counterOffer":"Brand will pay 50% of the Fee on signature and the balance within fifteen (15) days after the last Deliverable is published. A Deliverable is accepted if Brand does not raise a specific written objection within five (5) business days of receiving it. Late payments carry interest of 1.5% per month.","matchedRedLineId":"seed-2"},{"clauseType":"exclusivity","severity":"high","sourceSentence":"During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, Creator shall not create, publish or promote content for any company that Brand considers to be a competitor in the beauty, wellness or lifestyle categories.","whatItMeans":"For the whole contract and a year after it ends, you can't work with any beauty, wellness or lifestyle company the brand decides is a competitor.","whyDangerous":"The brand alone decides who counts as a competitor, and the categories cover most of the work a creator in this space does. The ban runs a year past the end of the deal and the fee doesn't pay you for it.","counterOffer":"During the Term only, Creator will not publish paid content for the facial serum products of the companies listed in Schedule B. This does not apply to agreements Creator disclosed before signing.","matchedRedLineId":null},{"clauseType":"indemnification","severity":"high","sourceSentence":"Creator shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Brand and its affiliates, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all claims, losses, damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to the Content or this Agreement, without limitation as to amount.","whatItMeans":"If anyone makes a claim against the brand that has anything to do with your content or this contract, you pay for it, including their lawyers, with no upper limit.","whyDangerous":"The amount you could owe has no cap, so one claim could cost you more than the whole fee. It also covers claims the brand caused, like a product complaint about the serum.","counterOffer":"Each Party will indemnify the other against third-party claims caused by its own breach of this Agreement or its own negligence. Creator's total liability under this Agreement will not exceed the Fee.","matchedRedLineId":null},{"clauseType":"termination-or-unilateral-amendment","severity":"medium","sourceSentence":"Brand may amend the Campaign Brief or any term of this Agreement at any time by sending notice to Creator, and Creator's continued performance after that notice constitutes acceptance of the amended terms.","whatItMeans":"The brand can change the contract whenever it likes just by telling you. If you keep working, you've agreed to the change.","whyDangerous":"The terms you sign today might not be the terms you end up held to. The brand could add Deliverables or change the schedule halfway through, after you've already started.","counterOffer":"Any change to this Agreement or to the Deliverables in the Campaign Brief must be in writing and signed by both Parties. Changes that add work will be paid at a rate agreed in that writing.","matchedRedLineId":null},{"clauseType":"termination-or-unilateral-amendment","severity":"medium","sourceSentence":"Brand may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason, on seven (7) days' written notice, and in that event no portion of the Fee shall be owed for Deliverables not yet accepted.","whatItMeans":"The brand can end the deal for any reason with a week's notice and owes you nothing for work it hasn't accepted yet.","whyDangerous":"You do the work up front and get paid at the end. The brand could cancel after you've filmed everything and walk away without paying.","counterOffer":"If Brand terminates for convenience, Brand will pay for all Deliverables completed or in progress at the date of notice, plus a kill fee of 25% of the remaining Fee.","matchedRedLineId":null},{"clauseType":"morality","severity":"medium","sourceSentence":"If Creator engages in any conduct that, in Brand’s sole judgment, brings Creator or Brand into public disrepute — whether or not related to the Campaign — Brand may terminate this Agreement immediately and Creator shall repay all Fees previously received.","whatItMeans":"If the brand decides anything you do, even outside the campaign, makes you or it look bad, it can end the deal on the spot and make you pay back everything you've earned.","whyDangerous":"The brand alone decides what counts, and it reaches your whole life rather than just the campaign. You could have to repay money for work the brand has already published and kept.","counterOffer":"Brand may terminate if Creator is convicted of a crime or publicly makes statements that are hateful or harassing, as reasonably determined. Creator keeps fees for Deliverables already published, and no other repayment is owed.","matchedRedLineId":null},{"clauseType":"auto-renewal","severity":"medium","sourceSentence":"This Agreement will automatically renew for successive six (6) month terms unless Creator gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.","whatItMeans":"The contract renews itself every six months unless you cancel in writing at least two months before it ends.","whyDangerous":"If you miss the deadline you're locked in for another six months, and that includes the exclusivity ban, without anyone agreeing on a new fee.","counterOffer":"This Agreement ends at the end of the Term. The Parties may extend it only by a written agreement that sets a new fee.","matchedRedLineId":"seed-7"}]}
